title: Maple Hollow Rising Revisited
author: L. M. Sterling
blurb: Dominic Okonkwo, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
